༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum

(nga)pa'i dkar chag / ka ja mchod gtsug gi nor bu/ kha bsang rngan gyi cho ga nyes pa rnams sel dgos 'dod kun 'grub/ ga bsang rngan gyi cho ga mdor bsdus dge legs kyi rol mtsho/ nga bsang shin tu bsdus pa/ ca nor lha dang dman pa'i chu sbyin brul gtor dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga rnam 'dren sbyin pa'i shing rta sogs gtor chog gi rim pa/ cha gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga mdor bsdus/ ja 'jam dpal chab gtor mdor bsdus tshogs gnyis kyi gru chen/ nya drang srong dri med la chu gtor 'bul ba tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin/ ta 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma dam pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs yang dag pa/ tha rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes dkar cha bzhi/ bar do cha bzhi/ klu gtor bsdus pa/ da klu gtor rgyas pa sbyin pa'i lang tsho nā ga me na ka na cha gsum gtor ma mdor bsdus phrin las 'grub byed/ pa gtor bsngos bsdus pa/ pha gtor bsngos nyung ngu phrin las kun 'grub/ ba bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i gtor bsngos chung ngu*/ ma chos kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gtor ma la brten nas bskang zhing gsol ba/ tsa bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i glang po'i cho ga bzang ngan brtag pa/ tsha dud sol lha mo'i gtor chog paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen lugs mkha' 'gro myos pa'i nga ro/ dza rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho/ wa dbul sel nam mkha'i bang mdzod gter gyi snye ma/ zha gza' bdud kyi rlung gi 'khor lo'i las byang*/ za gza' bdud dug gi spu gri'i las byang ngag sgrig bstan dgra 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ 'a lha chen tshangs pa'i gsol mchod phrin las kyi shing rta/ ya chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi'i gsol kha/ ra lha chen nag lha dzaṃ bha'i bsang mchod/ la ra khyim klu btsan gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa/ sha rnga thug rten 'dzugs las mthun kun 'grub/ sa dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig rtsa nyi ma'i snang ba/

ha bde gshegs chos sku'i mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa byin rlabs kyi 'od phreng*/ a sa bdag lto 'phye chen po brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa nyes pa kun sel/ ki ring bsrel lnga'i gzhug tshul lag len tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ ku nam mkha'i sad srung nyi zla 'od sprin gyi lo glud zab mo/ ke rang lugs kyi rnga grangs/
